description: This source file contains unit tests for the DeepLinkAgentPolicy module, testing message validation and delivery efficacy logic related to deep linking policies in a messaging application.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPolicyTests
classes.description: A struct containing various unit tests for the DeepLinkAgentPolicy functionality, including message validation and delivery logic.

methods.name: `validate message for handle rejects too long when unkeyed`
methods.description: Tests that messages exceeding the maximum length are rejected when the link is unkeyed.

methods.name: `validate message for handle allows too long when keyed`
methods.description: Tests that long messages are allowed when the link is keyed and unattended.

methods.name: `effective delivery ignores delivery fields when unkeyed`
methods.description: Checks that delivery is not enabled and recipient info is null when the link is unkeyed.

methods.name: `effective delivery honors deliver for deliverable channels when keyed`
methods.description: Ensures that delivery is enabled and recipient info is set correctly when the link is keyed and channel is deliverable.

methods.name: `effective delivery still blocks web chat delivery when keyed`
methods.description: Verifies that delivery remains disabled for web chat channels even when the link is keyed and delivery is requested.
